messages:
Marta (Customer Success): Heads up — Acme Corp flagged a month-end mismatch. Dashboard CSV shows 1,254,321 total tokens for Feb 28 cut, invoice attached shows 1,290,000 and they were bumped into the Pro tier on the invoice. Can we triage? :thinking:
Sam (Support): Ugh. Can you paste invoice id + customer id? Also which dashboard export (UI CSV or API)?
Marta (Customer Success): Invoice ID INV-2026-0457, customer_id acme-001, CSV exported from Dashboard -> Usage -> Export (UTC timezone option unchecked). Attached quick screenshot link: https://redwood-internal/attachments/INV-2026-0457.png
Sam (Support): Thanks. Quick checks: 1) are we comparing identical time windows? 2) any recent plan change for the account near midnight? 3) did they use batch uploads / retries?
Marta (Customer Success): They did a plan change on Feb 28 23:58 PST -> should be 06:58 UTC Mar 1. In UI the CSV defaulted to local timezone (PST) so I exported with local bounds of Feb 1 00:00 -> Feb 28 23:59. Invoice is showing Mar 1 cutoff per billing policy (UTC day).
Arjun (Eng): Possible cause: dashboard export used local timezone so included some events that the billing pipeline attributed to next invoice (or vice versa). Also if ingestion laged, billing aggregator may have excluded late events. Can you share a quick sample of event rows?
Marta (Customer Success): Pasted a tiny excerpt below from the CSV (cols: ts, request_id, tokens):
```
2026-02-28T23:58:12-08:00, rq_9a3b, 1024
2026-02-28T23:58:48-08:00, rq_9a3b, 1024  # retry duplicate
2026-02-28T23:59:05-08:00, rq_f2c1, 512
```
Sam (Support): That retry looks suspicious — dashboard export is a raw events dump and doesn't dedupe on request_id. Billing pipeline dedupes by request_id and by ingestion window. If the retry arrived before the dedupe TTL, it would be ignored — but the dashboard CSV will show both rows.
Arjun (Eng): Confirming: billing ingestion job applies dedupe on (customer_id, request_id) within 1h window. Also the billing cutover is at UTC midnight. Two issues combine: 1) timezone mismatch between user export and invoice, 2) dashboard CSV includes retries.
Kai (Finance): From finance POV, the invoice is generated from the billing ledger which uses UTC cutover and deduped counts. However, tier assignment uses the peak daily tally within the billing period. If dashboard CSV used PST window, the plan change at 23:58 PST could shift tokens between days and push them into next tier on invoice. We should explain this to Acme and propose a provisional credit if churn risk is high.
Sam (Support): Proposed repro query for eng to run against prod metering to compare both windows (use UTC and account for dedupe):
```
-- tokens per day (UTC window) deduped by request_id
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as day,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN token_count IS NOT NULL THEN request_id END) as distinct_calls,
       SUM(token_count) as total_tokens
FROM metering.events
WHERE customer_id = 'acme-001'
  AND created_at >= '2026-02-01'::timestamptz
  AND created_at <  '2026-03-01'::timestamptz
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
```
Arjun (Eng): Running now on staging-ish replica, will run on prod after approval. Also will add a quick dedupe query to show duplicates by request_id in that date range.
metering-bot: Billing job run: invoice INV-2026-0457 created 2026-03-02T02:12:05Z (ledger v3.1).
Arjun (Eng): Quick findings (prod query): total_tokens(UTC) = 1,289,740, dashboard CSV (PST window, raw rows) = 1,254,321, duplicates found = ~30k tokens from ~120 retry request_ids, and a timezone shift moved ~5,000 tokens into next UTC day which impacted tiering threshold.
Sam (Support): Summary for Acme: invoice is correct per ledger (UTC cutover + dedupe). Dashboard CSV from the UI used local timezone and is raw events (no dedupe). That explains the delta and the tier bump.
Marta (Customer Success): Ok please prepare a short note we can send: 1) explain root cause, 2) attach repro query and CSV of duped request_ids, 3) offer provisional credit for user confusion and check whether tier bump will be reversed.
Kai (Finance): I'll approve a one-time credit if we determine their effective billed tokens exceed dashboard by >2% caused by UI export differences — but looks like invoice is > dashboard, we need to be careful. Recommend we: a) credit the difference for goodwill b) schedule a product fix so CSV export has timezone toggle and a "dedupe by request_id" option.
Arjun (Eng): Filed ENG-6139 to add dedupe toggle to UI export and a warning about invoice cutover timezone. Assigning to me, ETA next sprint.
Sam (Support): I'll draft reply to Acme with the explanation and ask if they want immediate credit.
Marta (Customer Success): Thanks all. Marking this as high-priority customer escalation. Please cc me on the reply. :thumbsup:
